name: tovu-theme
description: Builds Tovu themes two ways: scaffolds a new theme (static, templated or declarative tier; hand-authored, or compiled from a React/Vue/Angular build), or converts an existing static website (plain HTML/CSS/JS, no Tovu, no CMS) into a Tovu static-tier theme. Encodes the theme-format rules a generic approach gets wrong: apiVersion 2's render/pages+render/partials+css/theme.css+scripts layout, the manifest keys the live loader actually reads (slots, flat modes/defaultMode) versus planned ones it ignores, which of tokens.json/tokens.light.json holds which palette regardless of the source's own default, the publishedPages allow-list that leaves every non-index page unreachable until explicitly turned on, the narrow href=/src= sentinel rewrite that never touches a JS fetch() call, a compiled build's required artifactHashes, and which binary assets an agent tool can bring in (fonts and images from a URL, via theme_import_file_from_url) versus which need a human copy. A new theme starts, by default, as a theme_duplicate copy of an existing theme that is then restyled and activated only after the owner approves; everything runs on fs_read_file/fs_list_files plus the existing theme_* tools.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Designs a new theme for your site, or turns a website you already have into one.
